title: Subticket tree system + cross-area typed links
objective: Replace flat ticket list model with a first-class subticket hierarchy and explicit typed relationship edges between any tickets across areas. This enables: 1) Subtickets as independent tickets with full lifecycle that can be referenced from any other ticket (not just local phases in MDs), 2) Cross-area linking so ticket A in area/engine can legitimately be a subticket of ticket B in area/sandbox, 3) Explicit typed links (blocks/blocked_by/depends_on/triggers/references/duplicates/spans/supersedes) with automatic reverse-edge registration, 4) Cycle detection to prevent infinite traversal in recursive subtickets, 5) Global _links.json edge table for O(1) lookup vs per-file parsing.
